FIELDS.NAME: Color Haven Paint & Wallpaper
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Color Haven Paint & Wallpaper operates as a retail establishment specializing in the sale of a comprehensive array of paint, wallpaper, and related home improvement supplies. Our primary focus is providing exceptional customer service and expert advice to both residential and commercial customers. We are strategically located in a commercial shopping center that ensures convenient access for walk-in customers. Our store features an organized showroom with a wide selection of products, including eco-friendly and low-VOC options, catering to diverse customer needs.

We offer in-store color matching and consultation services to help customers choose the right products for their projects, while maintaining compliance with all necessary environmental and safety regulations regarding the storage and disposal of chemicals. Our staff is trained in the safe handling of the materials we sell, ensuring a safe shopping experience for our customers. Additionally, we emphasize community engagement by hosting workshops on painting and wallpapering techniques, which further enhances our customer relationships and promotes indoor DIY projects.

With a focus on maintaining a clean and inviting atmosphere, we aim to provide an enjoyable shopping experience while adhering to best practices in retail operations, ensuring that our business is well-positioned for long-term success in the industry.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in on-site painting, wallpaper installation, or contracting services, and confirms that it solely focuses on retail operations with primary sales of paint, wallpaper, and related supplies. Additionally, we do not store significant amounts of hazardous or flammable chemicals without compliant containment and ventilation, and we are fully compliant with all applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Color Haven Home Decor and Supplies, LLC - A retail store specializing in home decor items, including furniture, lighting, and decorative accessories, with an emphasis on providing quality products and exceptional customer service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a minor incident occurred when a customer accidentally spilled paint in the store, causing damage to the flooring. The estimated cost of repairs was $1,500. The claim was filed and has been settled with the contractor, and the repairs have been completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, Fire-Rated Vault with UL certification; equipped with a dual-key locking mechanism for enhanced security.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and regular patrols by hired security personnel to ensure the safety of the premises and protect against theft or vandalism.
